g.title: spatial_upscaler
g.text: FSR 1-style spatial upscaler: Lanczos resampling followed by contrast-adaptive sharpening, behind one AXI4-Lite port
s_axis -> scaler_lanczos (any size change) -> sharpen_cas -> m_axis - 1 pixel per clock end to end
pixel = CHANNELS x COMP_W bits (default 3 x 8), component 0 in the LSBs

g.title: split
g.text: AW / W held until both are present

g.title: note
g.text: the scaler OUT_SIZE: program the sharpener
and enable it before enabling the scaler

g.title: sfb
g.text: 6x6 window per clock (8 x 8 RAM banks)
sized for the input: MAX_W x MAX_H

g.title: sdp
g.text: 1 output pixel per clock, any size change

g.title: slb
g.text: sized for the output width: OUT_MAX_W

g.title: scas
g.text: front end: read address, RAM read,
